perks.name: Surplus

enhanced.name: Feeding Frenzy
enhanced.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

enhanced.name: Pulse Monitor
enhanced.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
enhanced.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

enhanced.name: Outlaw
enhanced.description: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.

perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Focused Fury

enhanced.name: Focused Fury
enhanced.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

enhanced.name: Turnabout

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie

perks.name: Osmosis

enhanced.name: Frenzy

enhanced.name: Surrounded

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

enhanced.name: Elemental Capacitor
enhanced.description:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

enhanced.name: Adagio
enhanced.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.
